name: trade-house
description: Plateforme de gestion et de suivi de traders

scripts.check:all: npm run typecheck && npm run check:calls && npm run check:actions && npm run check:perms && npm run check:pages
scripts.verify:crypto: tsc src/lib/totp.ts src/lib/crypto.ts --outDir .tmp-totp --module commonjs --target es2022 --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop && node --env-file=.env.local scripts/verify-totp.cjs
scripts.verify:email: tsc src/lib/email.ts --outDir .tmp-email --module commonjs --target es2022 --moduleResolution node --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop && node scripts/verify-email.mjs
scripts.verify:reports: tsc src/lib/storage.ts --outDir .tmp-storage --module commonjs --target es2022 --moduleResolution node --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop && node --env-file=.env.local scripts/verify-reports.mjs
scripts.verify:export: tsc src/lib/pdf.ts --outDir .tmp-pdf --module commonjs --target es2022 --moduleResolution node --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop && node scripts/verify-export.mjs
scripts.verify:room: tsc src/lib/room-token.ts --outDir .tmp-room --module commonjs --target es2022 --moduleResolution node --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop && node --env-file=.env.local scripts/verify-room.mjs
